package: RGK Fall 2018 6.535 GeV provisional reduced cross sections
analysis_note: Provisional RGK Fall 2018 extraction using the closure-selected one-iteration IBU result and joint data-and-response count-bootstrap covariance
csv_definition: one row per final-valid 4D cross-section bin
uncertainty_scope: propagated data and finite-MC counting uncertainty including finite radiative-correction MC uncertainty; remaining campaign systematic covariance is not included
current_efficiency_treatment: campaign current-efficiency weighting referenced to 35 nA

samples.label: RGK Fall 2018, 6.535 GeV, torus+1
samples.phase_space_definition: exclusive physical 4D bin and Q2 >= 1 and W >= 2 and electron p >= 1 GeV
samples.final_validity_definition: acceptance above minimum, reliable radiative correction, reliable bin centering, finite nonnegative corrected yield, finite positive propagated uncertainty, and positive physical volume and virtual-photon flux
samples.covariance_definition: cross-section covariance among phi bins within each (Q2,xB,-t) cell, propagated from unfolding corrected_covariance_phi
samples.uncertainty_definition: diagonal square root of covariance_phi: propagated data and finite-response count-bootstrap uncertainty plus finite radiative-correction MC uncertainty; remaining campaign systematic covariance is absent
